answer: To resist sybils, treat every new key as a bonded relic parked on a quarantine island. The applicant locks a minimum stake for three epochs and may not vote or draw emission until five established peers each attest a distinct work receipt that cites that bond's txid and a unique nonce. A diversity prism then collapses raters whose first-seen funding paths intersect into one vote, and any peer may endorse at most one applicant per epoch. If two relics later share a parent UTXO, both bonds are slashed, so mass-minted clones never leave the island.
